content.text: ▪︎glomerular immune complex dz from nephritogenic GAS strains
▪︎DX also: ⇣ CH50, azotemia, proteinuria; BX ⍉typically needed
▪︎prognosis: children excellent (most full recovery); adults (esp >60) may be poor w/ late kidney comps
⚠️ vs IgA nephropathy: hematuria 1–3 days after URI (synpharyngitic)
⚠️ Blueprint Q30 explanation “10–14 d for all” → skin = 3–6 wk.
young males w.in days (24-48h) after URI/GI infect
: gross hematuria & flank pain + acute URI	▪︎
genetic defect in type IV collagen
renal funct declines rapidly over days to wks
crescent form made of plasma proteins & fibrin
antibodies against type IV collage of the GBM
▪︎sm + medium vessel vasculitis (ear, nose, throat, lungs, kidneys)
: mesangial/subendothelial immune complex deposition (ex, anti-dsDNA/anti-Sm Ab), expansion/thickening of mesangium, cap walls, &/or GBM
: UA + creatinine, confirm w/ renal BX
▪︎PCN or erythromycin if strep infect still present
▪︎vol overload: loop (furosemide) + fluid restriction; HTN: PO nifedipine or IV nicardipine
▪︎dialysis: life-threatening fluid overload or hyperK refractory to meds, or severe azotemia (ex, BUN >89mg/dL)
▪︎GPA: glucocorticoids + MTX (limited dz); cyclophosphamide (more severe dz); rituximab
